items.title: Eddie Marshall interviewed by Monk Rowe, San Francisco, California, August 8, 2002
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] My name is Monk Rowe and we are in San Francisco filming for the Hamilton College Jazz Archive. I’m extremely pleased to have Eddie Marshall with me today... [INTERVIEWEE] Exactly

ctx.x: Drummer Eddie Marshall was born in Springfield, Massachusetts on April 13, 1938. He has performed with a long list of major jazz artists on both coasts and his name has become associated with San Francisco jazz. Eddie has also distinguished himself as a composer, band leader and performer on the alto recorder. He was honored at the San Francisco Jazz Festival in November of Eddie was interviewed in San Francisco, California on August 8, 2002 by Monk Rowe, Director of the Fillius Jazz Archive.

My name is Monk Rowe and we are in San Francisco filming for the Hamilton College Jazz Archive. I’m extremely pleased to have Eddie Marshall with me today, who is a drummer and composer and recordist.
